definition: Hindered or burdened by something unwanted.
author: Wilkie Collins
quote: Not the slightest embarrassment encumbered his explanation, though this was his first meeting with me after the scene in Montagu Square.
example_sentence: Encumbered with shopping bags, she missed the bus.
